title: de Havilland Mosquito DZ739
memorial_details: Upright, stained wood panels at side of field with metal plaque attached. Plaque has inscription with accident details and photo of crew.
inscription: ON THE AFTERNOON OF 31ST AUGUST 1943 / DH MOSQUITO NF MK2 DZ739 OF / 157 SQUADRON BASED AT RAF HUNSDON / CRASHED NEAR THIS SPOT DURING / A SHORT NIGHT FLYING TEST PRIOR TO OPERATIONS THAT EVENING / BOTH CREW MEMBERS LOST THEIR LIVES / (photo) / THIS PLAQUE IS DEDICATED TO PILOT P/O B.W. 'BARNEY' JOBLING / AND NAVIGATOR P/O F.W. 'FRED' WESTON. / REMEMBERED WITH PRIDE BY THEIR SONS AND FAMILIES. / 'LEST WE FORGET'
original_title: Pilot Officers B W Jobling and F W Weston
community_connection: Remembered With Pride by Their Sons And Families.
